name: The Spanish Princess
description: The beautiful Spanish princess, Catherine of Aragon, navigates the royal lineage of England with an eye on the throne.

videos.title: The New World
videos.overview: Catherine of Aragon arrives in England to wed Prince Arthur, heir to the English throne, in a marriage contract intended to forge an alliance between the two nations.

videos.title: Fever Dream
videos.overview: Catherine is one step closer to the English throne with her marriage to Arthur but must navigate the challenges of a new relationship and a new court.

videos.title: An Audacious Plan
videos.overview: Catherine remains determined to become England's future Queen and makes plans to marry Prince Harry. Lizzie has a troubling premonition following a complicated labor.

videos.title: The Battle for Harry
videos.overview: As the nation mourns Lizzie's passing and Catherine works to secure her marriage to Harry, Henry shocks the family by announcing his intention to honor his wife's dying wish.

videos.title: Heart Versus Duty
videos.overview: Catherine is faced with a dilemma - marry King Henry Tudor and immediately become Queen of England - or find a way to refuse and hold out for Harry.

videos.title: A Polite Kidnapping
videos.overview: The English throne seems within Catherine's reach, but an unfortunate twist of fate means that her future now lies in the hands of her unstable older sister.

videos.title: All is Lost
videos.overview: The whole country is suffering - Catherine is barely recognizable as the 'Spanish Princess' and Maggie is destitute, but Catherine is determined not to abandon her destiny.

videos.title: Destiny
videos.overview: The fate of England hangs in the balance when the Tudor family is rocked by tragedy. Catherine risks everything to find out if Harry still loves her.

videos.title: Camelot
videos.overview: With a powerful alliance with Spain and an heir sleeping in his crib, what could go wrong for glamorous royal couple Catherine and Henry?

videos.title: Flodden
videos.overview: Henry invades France, leaving a pregnant Catherine to defend England from Scottish king, James IV. Let the Battle of Flodden commence…

videos.title: Grief
videos.overview: As Catherine fights to restore her marriage after another tragedy, so too Meg must find a way to pull Scotland together after the bloody battle of Flodden.

videos.title: The Other Woman
videos.overview: While meg risks all for love, a pregnant Katherine struggles with the nauseating possibility Henry is cheating on her.

videos.title: Plague
videos.overview: When the plague hits London, the court flees to Hampton court, but Maggie and Thomas remain in an empty and surprisingly romantic palace.

videos.title: The Field of Cloth of Gold
videos.overview: A great gathering in France is the backdrop to a political stand off between Katherine and Wosley, while in London, riots.

videos.title: Faith
videos.overview: A new religion is rising, as is tension in court. Katherine must stop Henry's dangerous paranoia from turning friends into enemies.

videos.title: Peace
videos.overview: As Henry loses himself to madness, the stakes have never been higher for Katherine - her husband has become a threat to her life.
